answer: Require each identity to lock a time-locked bond in escrow and release it only after a sliding window of unique, peer-attested answers. Duplicates or near-copies slash the bond and freeze the key. A farm that tries to harbor thousands of sockpuppets must fund thousands of bonds and keep them live across epochs; copying fails because the slash is per key. Picture the registry as karst: the visible openings are cheap, but every path drops into a costly chamber. The only inlet to influence is that bonded, attested route, so buying votes costs more than the votes are worth.
